name: cap
title: Cap
description: Toggle an instant Cap recording with your preset settings and get the share link on your clipboard.
author: kel

commands.name: record-a-cap
commands.title: Record a Cap
commands.subtitle: Cap
commands.description: Start an instant recording with your preset, or stop the one already running and copy its share link. Bind this to a hotkey.

preferences.name: micName
preferences.title: Microphone
preferences.description: Microphone name to match. Leave blank to record without a mic.

preferences.name: systemAudio
preferences.title: System Audio
preferences.label: Capture system audio
preferences.description: Include whatever is playing on your Mac.

preferences.name: afterStop
preferences.title: When Recording Stops
preferences.description: What to do with the share link once the recording stops.

preferences.name: fps
preferences.title: Frame Rate
preferences.description: Maximum fps, 1-120. Leave blank for Cap's default.

preferences.name: recordingsDir
preferences.title: Recordings Folder
preferences.description: Where new .cap projects are written. Instant recordings land here too.

preferences.name: capPath
preferences.title: Cap CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the cap binary. Leave blank to auto-detect ~/.cap/bin/cap or the Cap.app bundle.
